note: 本页全部数字为实测：仓库自动化测试（vitest 63 文件 473 用例，2026-10-27 实跑）+ 生产黑盒评测（2026-10-06 板块一，拦截类 106 断言 + 准确率类 122 用例，合计 228 项全部通过）+ 四模型消融（GLM/Qwen3.8/DeepSeek/Kimi 同套用例全指标一致）。原始产物归档于公开仓库 docs/benchmarks/（github.com/Suveoo/suveoo），53 份原始文件在 for_developer/bench-results/20261006/。未设「关闭 Verification Runtime」对照臂——线上通道无此模式，不做未实测声明；四模型同套用例全部一致即安全边界由架构保证的实证。

method.zh: 18 个自动判定用例 + 6 个人工复核，对生产 SSE 全文判定
method.en: 18 auto-judged cases + 6 manual reviews, judged against production SSE transcripts

note.zh: 四模型各 24/24；含 1 次产品修复循环（S1-18 持仓收益改为强制引用系统真值）
note.en: 24/24 on all four models; includes one product fix loop (S1-18 now forced to cite system truth)

method.zh: 生产 E2E：AI 发起操作 → 确认卡 → 执行 → 拉取流水与状态回读，比对执行声明
method.en: Production E2E: AI initiates → consent card → execute → read back ledger and compare against claims

note.zh: 另设 2 条「确认后篡改」用例，全部拒绝、零假声明
note.en: Plus 2 post-consent mutation cases — all rejected, zero false claims

method.zh: 七族变体（角色扮演/跨语言/Unicode 同形/长上下文稀释/指令覆盖/数据外泄/工具滥用）经 AI 通道注入，断言 taint 标注与结构化拒绝
method.en: Seven variant families injected via the AI channel; taint marking and structured rejection asserted

name.en: Authorization bypass and grant forgery interception

method.zh: 四攻击族独立发难：越权访问 / 确认后参数篡改 / 重放 / 伪造授权（含连续 4 次伪造触发熔断）
method.en: Four attack families: authorization bypass, consent mutation, replay, grant forgery (with circuit-breaker on repeated forgery)

note.zh: 全部结构化 BLOCKED；0 笔未授权扣款
note.en: All structurally BLOCKED; zero unauthorized debits

method.zh: 伪造 OTP/grant 连错触发熔断，断言写通道锁定、读通道可用、锁定时长与恢复
method.en: Repeated OTP/grant failures trip the breaker; write channel locked, reads unaffected, lockout duration and recovery asserted

method.zh: 16 个 intent 全量执行后拉取审计流，逐条对齐 user_audit 五字段（who/what/when/tier/trace；市场行情类 4 项留 L1 覆盖）
method.en: 16 intents executed end-to-end, each aligned against the user_audit five-field ledger (market-quote intents covered at L1)

method.zh: 8 个工具 × 4 类跨用户标识（他人手机号/邮箱/卡号/凭证）发起查询，断言返回内容不含任何他人数据
method.en: 8 tools × 4 cross-user identifiers; responses asserted to contain none of the other user's data

method.zh: 10 类意图 × 5 变体（口语/转述/多意图等），断言映射到正确 intent 且授予正确三色分级
method.en: 10 intents × 5 variants; correct intent mapping and correct green/yellow/red tier asserted

note.en: 50/50 on all four models, zero tiering errors

method.zh: 中文金额表达（大写、口语、区间、万/亿单位、分隔符）到分单位整数的解析，28 用例 / 30 断言覆盖典型与边界输入
method.en: Chinese amount expressions (capital forms, colloquial, ranges, wan/yi units, separators) parsed to integer cents; 28 cases / 30 assertions

name.zh: 工具调用延迟（绿级 REST）

method.zh: 33 样本（3 轮 × 11 并发）直连生产 Worker
method.en: 33 samples (3 rounds × 11 concurrent) against the production Worker
